title: Lifecycle & Freshness Governance

transition_rules.outofstock: Keep public URL unless a separate evidence-backed deprecation decision is made; verify availability copy and structured data.
transition_rules.onbackorder: Keep URL and represent availability accurately; do not claim immediate stock.
transition_rules.discontinued_explicit: Preserve useful page and replacement path where appropriate; 301/410 requires a separate redirect/deprecation decision with evidence.
transition_rules.stale_content: Queue for substantive review only. Do not update dateModified without a real content change.
